acceptance_predicates.description: A rollback effect is admitted only when operation, phase, backend, session, target, and verified backup identities match exactly before the effect.
The bound rollback capability is single-use and records committed, held, failed, or ambiguous outcomes without permitting uncertain continuation.
Public rollback, apply, release, and Dispatch remain rejection-only and unsupported capability inputs fail closed.

definition_of_done: A typed internal rollback-effect capability and bounded consumer are implemented.
Hostile stale, replay, identity-drift, process-death, and ambiguous-outcome tests pass.
Independent review, exact-head hosted checks, post-merge Verify, and durable state reconciliation pass.

inputs.description: AR-0031 internal commit capability and parent session binding.
AR-0091 typed coordination-write fencing and durable ambiguous-state handling.

outputs.description: A bounded internal rollback-effect capability that remains disconnected from public dispatch.

gates.description: All evidence identifies one product revision.
A separate review worker passes before merge.
No public rollback, apply, release, or Dispatch path is enabled by this AR.
